verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway explicitly documents load balancing across multiple LLM models/providers with dynamic routing optimized on various metrics, plus cost calculation and latency tracking per request, which together give the building blocks for weight/latency/cost-based routing. However, the docs don't explicitly confirm weighted-by-cost or weighted-by-latency algorithms as first-class configurable balancing strategies (only 'various metrics' is vaguely referenced), and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates this in production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concrete weight/latency/cost-based load-balancing algorithms and configuration examples, and independent verification of this behavior in practice.
